beats.say: Ralph Fiennes joins the Hunger Games cast for the new prequel.
The legendary actor stars alongside Glenn Close and Elle Fanning in this story.
Joseph Zada plays a young Haymitch Abernathy, while Mckenna Grace is Maysilee Donner.
Kieran Culkin, Jesse Plemons, and Maya Hawke also round out the massive main cast.
Whitney Peak and Kelvin Harrison Jr. are confirmed for the 50th Hunger Games arena.
Having this many award winning stars for a prequel shows how big the stakes are.
Part 3 reveals the final names and the official release details.

Joseph Zada plays young Haymitch Abernathy.
Mckenna Grace will play tribute Maysilee Donner in the film.
